chansons.style: indie pop rock, jangly guitars, dreamy synths, heartfelt male vocals, melancholic, 118 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une rupture amoureuse racontée à travers l'image de fils qui se défont lentement.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(jangly guitar arpeggio)
Oh-oh-oh

[Verse 1]
Your coffee cup still sits beside the sink
I haven't moved it, haven't dared to think
The hallway echoes with a hollow sound
Your shadow's gone but still it hangs around

[Pre-Chorus]
We built this house on whispered promises
Now every brick is crumbling into dust

[Chorus]
Unraveled threads, we're coming undone
Two separate stories where we were one
Unraveled threads slipping through my hands
I'm learning how to be alone again

[Verse 2]
The photographs are fading on the wall
I trace your smile before the seasons fall
We tried to stitch the fabric back in place
But every needle left another trace

[Chorus]
Unraveled threads, we're coming undone
Two separate stories where we were one
Unraveled threads slipping through my hands
I'm learning how to be alone again

[Bridge]
Maybe some things aren't meant to hold
Maybe the story already told
Itself completely, start to end

[Chorus]
Unraveled threads, we're coming undone
Two separate stories where we were one

[Outro]
Oh-oh-oh, alone again
Oh-oh-oh, unraveling

[Outro]
Oh-oh, one stitch at a time
